Nice start, thanks @lebaphi 

We have some contrast issues now that the component is running inside Serge:
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/715fb3ac-2339-40e9-9128-c523d95dd4b7)

So, it _looks-like_ we'll pass a handler to `CoreMapping`.  Then `CoreMapping` will catch changes to the `featureCollection` and send details to the handler.   The `CoreMappingChannel` handler will then send out the new message in `saveMessage` - just like the `ChatChannel` does.
Hello @lebaphi  - I did have a go at fixing the conflict, but I got it wrong.  Hopefully you will do better.

issues.title: Core Mapping - Introduce new mapping channel
issues.body:
We have our new core-mapping component.

The `story` for it includes mock channel data and mock messages.

I have modified database `l6nngxlk` to include a mapping channel and a mapping message that contains features.

Now we can modify `factory.tsx` to show a `MappingChannel` when the channel is of type `CHANNEL_MAPPING`.

The `MappingChannel` should pass all messages for this channel to the `CoreMapping` component, for them to be displayed.

This issue just covers the creation of the mapping channel, which will contain an instance of `CoreMapping` - and show the data from `l6nngxlk` wargame.  I _guess_ that `CollabChannel` is a good starting point for this new component.
